title: Autonomous Physics Lab: the rover that learns the planet
description: Mission in plain language -> route on the orbital map -> multibody VIPER drive -> stall in soft sand mapped as regolith -> soil learned from the wheels (iterated EKF) -> replanned route -> trust report against the physics and the known truth of a synthetic site.

params.mission: Leve o rover até (37, 15) sem atolar, escorregamento máximo de 40%, minimizando a energia.
